teacher_info.about_teacher: I want to first understand your goals and build the structure of our class from there. As someone who has experienced Italki as a student and has had different experiences with how helpful different teaching styles are, I have the lived experience of what is helpful as a student learning a new language. I feel that orientating firstly around your goals is most important. Secondly, I feel often the time can pass just chatting without really delving into your problem areas or goals. It will be my goal as your teacher to of course converse naturally, but also I want to remain attentive to that grammatical mistakes aren't repeating and we are making genuine progress in our sessions together!
teacher_info.teaching_style: My teaching style is mixed between relaxed and open but also attentive and disciplined and aware of the progress we are making. As I said above, we tend to make similar mistakes as foreign language learners. I want our sessions to be open time to practice speaking but include room for correction and growth. It will be my goal to strike a balance between the two. In terms of content, again the session is dictated by your goals and from there we can cover a range of topics from art to culture to politics to travel, to whatever most interests you.

course_info.trial_description:
In our trial lesson we will first get to know each other's background and then get to know your wants and needs and your goals and also your expectations on what you are trying to achieve. 

1. WARMER (Here will will go over basics, basics such as conversations. in these conversations i will be asking you questions, and you will be answering them and you will do the same thing to me as well).

- During this warmer we will build rapport with each other and i will be listening to see how your grammar and pronunciation of words are and also ask you different questions on what you like and dislike and where are you at currently in your English learning journey. 

2. BASIC PRACTICE (Here we will go over a basic understanding of Vowels, Indefinite Articles, Nouns, Pronouns and such other forms of the English language to gauge your knowledge on what you know about them.
-What is your Level of speaking
-What is your level of listening
-what is your level of understanding

All of this is included into our first trial lesson together to see exactly what information that you know currently about the English language.

pro_course_detail.title: Learning English Basics: Getting better with fun conversations
pro_course_detail.description:
1. Beginners: Student will learn the basics of the English Pronunciation System. yes, there is a special way that Americans and People from the U.K. speak and by listening and speaking you to will be able to understand some of the most difficult words spoken colloquially by English speakers from all over the word. Connective speech and etc. So, grab your pen and be ready to listen, repeat and take notes. 

2. Beginners: Student will be practicing words and breaking them down into Syllables, learning vowels and phrases to speak many English words with proficiency.

3. Students will be quizzed on words, Phrases, vowels, and various forms of the English language to see how their progress is going and to move on to higher levels of communication and vocabulary. 

4. Videos, Articles, worksheets, and other various forms of English learning documents will be given to students during class and as homework to continue learning even when they are away from class.

*All students will go through conversations with the Tutor on many different topics and will receive teaching documents and videos to improve every aspect of their English learning experience.

pro_course_detail.title: Business English: From Informal to Formal
pro_course_detail.description:
1. Student will learn the basics and differences between informal and formal English.

2. Tutor and student will work 1 on 1 mastering the skills needed to speak professionally for the particular job or place that they are interested in going to or working at.

3. Student will take ordinary basic English words and turn them into words of meaning for everyday business conversations and pronouncing them correctly for understanding. 

4. Students' Vocabulary, Grammar, and pronunciation are expected to increase to achieve the level of professionalism for business endeavors.

pro_course_detail.title: "Grammatically Correct"
pro_course_detail.description: Learn the Basics of English Grammar, starting off with nouns (Singular and Plurals), verbs, tenses, SVO Word structure, phrasal verb structures, contractions Active and passive voice, and all other forms of English Grammar that will take your English to the next level or speaking.

teacher_info.teaching_style:
Conversation lessons will be centered around a topic and I will ask you questions about that topic that are at your level and are also designed to challenge you. We will chat as friends and you won't have to go over grammar drills.

TOEFL lessons will provide you with opportunities to practice real speaking activities from the test. For these lessons I require you to already have a B2 level. I will share tips about grammar, transitional words, introductions, and conclusions. 

In general English lessons, we will use articles, discussion questions, videos, and games. Depending on your level we will drill grammar, have written homework assignments, and vocabulary practice.

teacher_info.teaching_style:
I believe that enjoying yourself while learning a language is very important. Therefore, one of the first questions will be, "What interests or hobbies do you have?" I will then create curriculum based on what you mentioned. I am a conversational teacher who is outgoing, energetic and active. If you are interested, we can learn English through song lyrics, books, social media posts, sports videos, and dramas/movies. I can even teach you English through Tae Kwon Do lessons or by doing your favorite activity together. 
  I will often use Quizlet, Google Drive, Docs, and PowerPoint to relay new vocabulary and grammar structures that we learn during classroom activities or conversations.

course_info.trial_description:
Trial Lesson structure:       

        First, we will get to know each other and have a time for questions. Feel free to ask me any question. I look forward to learning about you and your goals. Then, I will briefly explain my lesson structure and teaching method. Next, based on a topic of your interest, I will come up with a dialogue or use a piece from the internet to learn more about you and this topic. Then, we will practice reading this dialogue together and focus on pronunciation. I will then make a Google Document for us to share, listing new vocabulary or grammar structures. We will then make fun sentences together using these words. 

Homework and Tests: 

      Depending on your level of interest, I can create homework and tests to evaluate your progress. But you get to control your learning pace and therefore do not have to take a single test or have any homework if that is your desire. My main focus is to help make learning fun for you so that you will feel motivated to learn more. So if you want a more or less interactive lesson, please let me know. 

About me: 
      I have had over 2 years of teaching experience. I have taught English to Chinese students online for a year and have taught English to Korean students in person for a year. I am extroverted and love meeting new people. I am open to adjusting lessons to better suit you. So let me know if you want to learn English by watching movies, reading books, cooking together, singing, dancing or doing some other activity. I can also speak some Mandarin Chinese and Korean if you need some help in translation. But our main focus, of course, will be communicating in English. I look forward to meeting you!

teacher_info.about_me: Hi, my name's Erin and I've been teaching English in Sevilla, Spain since 2008.  I'm originally from Wisconsin in the United States, which is between Canada and Chicago. I have a degree in social work, but after working as a youth supervisor, I decided that it wasn't for me and I hopped on a plane to Sevilla to teach English and I haven't looked back! In Sevilla, I mostly spend time with my friends, having a few beers or glasses of wine and some tapas (small dishes of food from Southern Spain). I also enjoy reading, watching tv series, doing strength training workouts at home and trying out new recipes when cooking.  I also love going to the beach and going camping.
teacher_info.about_teacher: I have a TEFL certificate from TEFL International and I've also taught in academies or have given private lessons since 2008. As a teacher, I really care about my students and try to help them and give them support as much as I can. I always try to explain things as thoroughly as possible, often by giving examples or playing games, if you're interested, to help reinforce what we're studying. I also like using humor in my class to keep things interesting.
teacher_info.teaching_style: I like to give dynamic lessons to keep everyone interested through games, activities, songs or videos. I try to make sure that each lesson incorporates some sort of skills needed when learning a language, such as reading, writing, listening and speaking. I sometimes also use pop culture in my classes, whether it's talking about a popular song, tv programme or film, using different kinds of apps in lesson plans or talking about current events. I cater to my students' needs and what they're interested in.

teaching_experience.description: I've taught many different levels, ranging from young learners (ages 5 and up), teenagers and adults. I've also specialised in teaching Cambridge exam strategy and I've had a 90% pass rate.

I teach many different levels, from young learners to adults. I plan dynamic classes and can easily adapt if something does not go according to plan. I also teach Cambridge levels, B1-C1 and I have a 95% pass rate.

pro_course_detail.title: German Conversation Lessons (A1-B2 LEVELS ONLY)
pro_course_detail.description:
For absolute beginners to advanced (up to C1 level) and serious students of the language. Book this course if you are learning German entirely from scratch, brushing up on your skills, or refining your skills.

These classes are for when you're looking for a no pressure conversation with corrections and exercises given at the end to solidify what you learned in each class.

pro_course_detail.title: Spanish Conversation Lessons (A1-B2 LEVELS ONLY)
pro_course_detail.description:
These classes are intended for total beginners of Spanish to low-mid intermediate learners (maximum B2 Spanish level to work with me). 

These classes are strictly conversation-based and involve corrections where desired, but no in depth explanation of grammar, etc. However, you may ask for outside resources that you can use after class for self study. 

You are welcome to bring a topic to class that you would like to discuss, or we can brainstorm one together.

pro_course_detail.title: English Conversation (ALL LEVELS)
pro_course_detail.description:
Hi everyone! Book these lessons if you would like to practice conversational English with a native speaker. If you have a topic in mind, let me know (or I can also pick out topics for us, you pick!). Though I am happy to lead the conversation, I ask my students to talk as much as possible (more than I even) to get the most out of their lessons while I give corrections. 
NOTE: I do NOT teach English grammar but will tell you how to say/how to pronounce what you would like to sound more natural.

See you in class!

pro_course_detail.title: Italian conversation lessons +  coaching (A1-B2 LEVELS ONLY)
pro_course_detail.description:
Ciao a tutti! Potete riservare una lezione con me per approfondire e migliorare le tue conoscenze della lingua italiana. 

These classes are purely for conversation practice. I am happy to suggest additional resources for self study of Italian outside of practicing in lessons.

I also have extensive experience in coaching language learners and love sharing tips with students on their general learning routines, learning efficiently and authentically + caring for their wellbeing as language learners, which we can discuss in the last few minutes of class if requested by the student.

pro_course_detail.title: Italian (Grammar, Writing, Speaking, Reading, Listening)
pro_course_detail.description:
If you're looking for a completely organized class for you focused on your strengths and improving any weaknesses in the areas of grammar, writing, speaking, reading, or listening, you're in the right place! I will provide a full curriculum and materials (going from A0 complete beginner, up to completion of B2 in Italian), with homework included if the student desires. This class is great for maintenance of your level, review, or having an engaging class that covers all bases you need to get you from one level to the next.

All materials will be organized for you via Google Drive.

pro_course_detail.title: Complete German Lessons (A1-B2 levels ONLY)
pro_course_detail.description:
Choose this class for a formal, structured teaching lesson to learn German, complete with grammar, writing, speaking, listening, and reading sections depending on your needs and determined level. This class is perfect, even with zero knowledge of German. We'll take your skills to the next level and ensure you have clarity and fun doing it!

 I have plenty of slides, presentations, and resources for those who would like a review of specific grammar concepts, vocabulary, topics of conversation, or learn German from scratch with me. I taught myself German as an adult up to a fluent (B2) level in all tested language skills before going to Germany myself, and completing my degree in German studies at university. My lesson plans contain many of these insights that came from my personal experience, as well as from time tutoring extensively (online+in person) German, materials from majoring in German, and time spent abroad in Germany.

I enjoy lesson planning and, according to your needs, I can tailor an individualized study plan complete with grammar, writing exercises, listening, and speaking during class, with homework at the end, or we can pick a more conversational route with grammar reminders and more vocabulary suggestions as desired. You will get your own personal Google Drive folder with all of our materials, no matter what you choose. I have extensive experience in coaching language learners and love sharing tips with students on their general learning routines, learning efficiently and authentically + caring for their wellbeing as language learners, which we can discuss in the last few minutes of class.
